content.short: Scroll is a native zkEVM Layer 2 network developed to scale Ethereum with full bytecode-level compatibility.
content.description:
Scroll is a leading developer-ready Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, powered by Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine (zkEVM) technology. Designed to provide a seamless transition for existing dApps, Scroll offers full bytecode-level compatibility, allowing developers to deploy their Ethereum-based smart contracts with zero code modifications. By utilizing advanced ZK-rollups, the network achieves high throughput and significantly lower transaction costs while inheriting the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet.

As a foundational infrastructure for the decentralized economy, Scroll supports a vibrant ecosystem of DeFi, gaming, and social applications. The network focuses on community-driven growth and open-source principles, serving as a vital venue for the next generation of scalable decentralized applications. Through its commitment to high performance and cryptographic integrity, Scroll is empowering builders to create secure and user-friendly tools that bring the power of Ethereum to a global audience with unparalleled efficiency.
content.meta: Scroll is a zkEVM Layer 2 network providing scalable and secure infrastructure for Ethereum decentralized applications.
